audit_status.source_base: ChatGPT-authored Psalms completion draft using public-domain KJV as familiar alignment scaffold with curated Hebrew/textual overrides; full WLC/OSHB/source-witness audit pending
audit_status.review_note: Praise, divine transcendence, poor people, barren woman imagery, and reversal.

verses.restored: Praise ye YHWH. Praise, O ye servants of YHWH, praise the name of YHWH.

familiar.text: Praise ye the LORD. Praise, O ye servants of the LORD, praise the name of the LORD.

modern.text: Hallelujah! Give praise, O servants of the LORD; praise the name of the LORD.

original.text: הַ֥לְלוּ יָ֨הּ הַ֭לְלוּ עַבְדֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה הַֽ֝לְלוּ אֶת שֵׁ֥ם יְהוָֽה

verses.restored: Blessed be the name of YHWH from this time forth and for evermore.

familiar.text: Blessed be the name of the LORD from this time forth and for evermore.

modern.text: Blessed be the name of the LORD both now and forevermore.

original.text: יְהִ֤י שֵׁ֣ם יְהוָ֣ה מְבֹרָ֑ךְ מֵֽ֝עַתָּ֗ה וְעַד עוֹלָֽם

verses.restored: From the rising of the sun to the going down of the same YHWH’s name is to be praised.

familiar.text: From the rising of the sun unto the going down of the same the LORD’s name is to be praised.

modern.text: From where the sun rises to where it sets, the name of the LORD is praised.

original.text: מִמִּזְרַח שֶׁ֥מֶשׁ עַד מְבוֹא֑וֹ מְ֝הֻלָּ֗ל שֵׁ֣ם יְהוָֽה

familiar.text: The LORD is high above all nations, and his glory above the heavens.

modern.text: The LORD is exalted over all the nations, His glory above the heavens.

original.text: רָ֖ם עַל כָּל גּוֹיִ֥ם יְהוָ֑ה עַ֖ל הַשָּׁמַ֣יִם כְּבוֹדֽוֹ

verses.restored: Who is like to YHWH our God, who dwelleth on high,

familiar.text: Who is like unto the LORD our God, who dwelleth on high,

modern.text: Who is like the LORD our God, the One enthroned on high?

verses.restored: Who humbleth himself to behold the things that are in heaven, and in the earth!

familiar.text: Who humbleth himself to behold the things that are in heaven, and in the earth!

modern.text: He humbles Himself to behold the heavens and the earth.

verses.restored: He raiseth up the poor out of the dust, and lifteth the needy out of the dunghill;

translation_notes: This chapter completes corpus coverage as a ChatGPT-authored draft. KJV is retained as a familiar comparison layer; a separate automated reference pass adds BSB and pointed Hebrew without replacing the restored draft.
safety_note: Infertility or childlessness must never be stigmatized; the poem’s reversal image is not a promise that every person will become a parent.
source_witness_audit_flags: Compare directly with WLC/OSHB, Septuagint, Dead Sea Psalms witnesses where extant, and other textual witnesses during the global audit. Preserve poetic parallelism, superscriptions, acrostic structure, duplicate/reused psalms, and significant Hebrew/Greek divergences rather than harmonizing them.
